newsitem.title: USA: Meridian Diagnostics launches E. coli test.
newsitem.headline: Meridian Diagnostics launches E. coli test.

text.p: Meridian Diagnostics Inc said Friday that it has begun selling its ImmunoCard STAT! 0157:H7 test for detecting E. coli in food.
This test utilizes two highly specific monoclonal antibodies isolated by U. S. Department of Agriculture.
ImmunoCard STAT! 0157:H7 was developed by Meridian to detect the most prevalent toxic sub-species of the deadly E. coli bacteria in minutes from a broth-enhanced food or animal sample.
